findings.title: export_statements opens a file handle inside the loop for every path
findings.note: export_statements calls open() on every iteration of the outer loop, and the inner read loop is a manual list-build (ruff PERF401) rather than a comprehension. Real per-file I/O cost on a hot path (export.py is in the hotspot band), not a cosmetic linter hit -- a linter-only finding with no hot-path reason would be severity 2, but this one runs per statement export.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: kind_labels loops over the Kind enum, a fixed two-member collection with a bounded N, not a data-dependent loop.
HEADER_RE is compiled once at import time via re.compile; not a per-iteration cost.
